_readme: Receptor-target spellings folded onto canonical names, produced by pipeline/audit/adjudicate.py --write-target-map. `cell` is the name two values must share before they may be compared; `base` is the receptor with every qualifier removed, which is what a class-level prior groups by. A `dropped` qualifier described the assay (species, tissue, radioligand); a `kept` one named a different entity or a different subunit/site and so keeps the rows apart.
